notes.title: Professions, Experience System, Balance Fixes
notes.content:
New Mechanics

 A new type of farming with fertilizers, as well as new resources such as carrots
 Added mining of underground shafts
 Added honey gathering with bees and hives
 Added collection of various alchemy ingredients in the Botany section
 Added the Easter Bunny, which can bring up to 7 eggs. Eggs contain random baby penguins, including Chaos and Divine
 Fishing now includes bait that increases efficiency
 Harvesting can now be limited by maximum per item type, not only per entire craft
 Implemented feather collection through Bony the Dragon, with a small chance to find a bull
 Ability to create: Steampunk Cart, Galley, and hatch the Easter Bunny from its egg


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038524/d5b4849151a058931c9ac93c686c4ea232e15ee1.png
Getting Professions
The game now allows you to obtain professional penguins permanently. To do this, you need to find rare components in harvesting
[olist]
 Coffee Seeds are obtained from logging. They are used to brew coffee.
 Red Clay can be obtained by rare red penguin children in expeditions, or by archaeological digs. It is used to craft clay dishes
 Fish Soup can be made from fish, seaweed, water, and clay dish
 Healing Salve can be made from juniper, seeds, green leaves, and ice. Juniper is obtained from logging or planting seeds
 Battery can be made by combining gold and diamond ore
[/olist]
Each type uses penguin children in crafting and can turn them into professional penguins

 Common penguin chick -> Coffee brewing -> Coffee Penguin
 Uncommon penguin chick -> Cooking Fish Soup -> Cook
 Rare penguin chick -> Firing Red Clay -> Blacksmith
 Epic penguin chick -> Brewing Healing Salve -> Doctor
 Legendary penguin chick -> Crafting Battery -> Engineer


Experience System Added
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038524/02fe1e41e6642e2cb79bd9713ccc5f68766229aa.png
Some penguins now show a progress bar for experience. Once full, a random penguin will level up:

 Coffee Penguin -> Farmer
 Lumberjack -> Great Lumberjack
 Penguin with Glasses -> Great Penguin with Glasses
 Dazed Penguin -> Great Dazed Penguin
 Builder Penguin -> Great Builder Penguin
 Bee Penguin -> Great Bee Penguin


Balance Changes

 Harvesting send limit increased from 1,000 to 10,000
 Possibility to obtain the Great Ship Blueprint in Archaeological Digs
 Reduced chance of obtaining the Sage’s Book
 Reduced tool breakage rates and penguin mortality
 Increased efficiency of unique characters in harvesting

notes.title: A new crafting system has been introduced
notes.content:
Dear players, we are pleased to present to you a new type of crafting for resource gathering in the game.  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038524/d7d7a8c4795453d047641878326f7e804219e22f.png  
The gathering consists of blocks that may contain different items for selection when starting the craft.

Instructions:  
[olist]  
 Activate the use of the specified character/item. If the item is activated, it will automatically be sent to the craft when available.  
 Resource consumption by the specified character/item per single craft use.  
 Gathering coefficient based on crafting results — multiplies the yield by the specified coefficient.  
 Craft completion speed coefficient — shortens the time by the specified multiplier.  
 Icon indicating the percentage chance of losing the item after the craft is completed.  
 Specify the remaining quantity of the item in the inventory at which crafting should stop. If set to 0, all items will be consumed to the last one.  
 The checkbox can disable this craft entirely. When disabled, no consumption will occur.  
 The maximum dispatch count controls how many times the craft will be launched per time cycle.  
 The base time for craft completion, later multiplied by the coefficients specified in the individual items.  
 Save the specified settings in the current craft configuration.  
[/olist]  

All coefficients are summed across different blocks.

notes.title: Change in Trading Principles in the Game
notes.content:
Change in Trading Principles in the Game
The game's trading system is undergoing a fundamental change. From now on, all trading will take place within the game, while only coins of various denominations will be traded on the Steam marketplace.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038524/f3b3c112ff98c3d8446f0119639c1b68e076f0e6.png

Frequently Asked Questions
Why were these changes made?
- We are gradually shifting from Steam inventories to our own in-game system to optimize systems and crafting. After the transition, we will completely remove items from Steam, keeping only coins for trading.
Can I still sell my items?
- Yes, you can sell your items in the in-game Marketplace tab.
Where can I get coins for trading?
- Basic coins can be converted by clicking the plus icon next to your Pencoins (Bronze, Silver, Gold).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038524/79c32213c0abecb28c07bf43f085bfd5afcda876.png
What can be sold on the Steam marketplace for money?
- Currently, exclusive high-rarity items and Nortopia coins are available for trade. Coins will remain permanently, as they serve as a means of exchange. Other items will gradually disappear from the marketplace.

notes.title: [b]Egg Surprise 2.0 - New Client, Localization, Player Market[/b]
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038524/b58e189de92efba2cdcc0715c4b868489740186f.png  
June 20, 2024, marked the release of Egg Surprise, and we have come a long way since then.  

Today, something special is happening—we have changed the game engine from Unity to Web technologies.  

What does this mean for you? A new design, new mechanics, and, most importantly, improved stability:  
  
 The website is now integrated directly into the game  
 Client localization has been added (we are in the process of improving the translation)  
 The "Energizer" booster has been introduced—this item increases drop chances from clicks and provides new loot  
  

We understand that such major changes may take some time to get used to, so we ask for your patience in fully experiencing the new client—it is truly more convenient for long-term use.  

Egg Surprise 2.0 is here!

notes.title: Last Update in 2024
notes.content:
Last Update in 2024

Added to the Game:

 Penguin God Crafting
 Extraction of Divine Doping, which guarantees the transformation of a penguin into a monster


This year turned out to be incredibly dynamic, and throughout 2024 we achieved a lot:
- Clicker games became a major trend.
- Competition in the genre reached unprecedented heights.
- However, many projects gradually faded into oblivion.

Nevertheless, Egg Surprise managed to stand out and create something unique. From a simple trend, we crafted an engaging, albeit short, story about the survival of poor penguins in the face of a vampire plague, farm overwork, child deaths, and even the emergence of gods.

Let’s revisit the key moments of this captivating story!

 At first, ghosts, penguins, and several important characters from our game Styria appeared.
 With the launch of the first items in the shop, the crafting system was introduced, and soon the first farms were built.
 Penguins perished on farms, bringing rare items. Bee invasions occurred, leading to the creation of clover. Farms began producing colorful eggs, as well as the first penguin chicks.
 Among the rare items, marked eggs appeared, accompanied by mysterious phenomena. Thus, various night creatures emerged in the penguin world.
 The first expedition allowed families to venture to abandoned farms to gather resources, marking the start of penguin resurrections.
 Penguin Papa was introduced to incubate eggs and produce rare penguins.
 Zombie penguins were allowed on farms. Later, the first major expedition to the Dead Valley was organized, where players could obtain Excalibur, Lucard's journal, a pentagram, and other rare items. Before this event, dog training and \"dog fever\" were added to the game.
 Penguins took up professions: foresters began cutting trees, while stunned penguins took to fishing. For the first time, it became possible to grow penguin families.
 A sacrificial cult emerged in the settlement to extract animal blood. Penguins learned to compensate for losses by raising penguin chicks. Later, magical portals appeared in the shop.
 Penguins with new professions began hatching from colorful eggs: engineers, blacksmiths, cooks, doctors, and farmers. Penguins started experimenting with syringes containing unknown liquids, leading to mutations.
 Lady Lamia, or the Goddess of Light, began resurrecting penguins without consequences. New mysterious eggs of unknown origin appeared.
 Fantastic creatures began appearing in forests and waters. Penguins randomly acquired succubi, fairies, and mermaids.
 A new era of craftsmanship and sea voyages dawned: shipbuilding began, and treasure hunting was introduced.
 The settlement improved: fishing hooks were replaced with nets. Monsters started performing penguin tasks and gained access to farms.
 The Elder Penguin revealed the secret of fire-making, paving the way for blacksmithing.
 Dragons appeared in the penguin world, fortunately friendly and helpful to the settlement.
 The dawn of penguin civilization led to the creation of a full-fledged economy and craftsmanship. It all started with simple penguins and their descendants.
 Now, the world features gods, chaos, true horrors in the form of abominations, and much more.


We want to end today’s news on a positive note and say that the era of penguins is just beginning. Ahead lies the migration to Northopia Island, but for now, we need to prepare seriously and gather as many resources as possible.

On behalf of the project authors, I express immense gratitude to our community for their unwavering support throughout the year, their patience, and for sticking with us no matter what. We’ve made our share of mistakes, but I’d like to focus on the incredible amount of work we’ve accomplished together and the universe we’ve built.

Happy New Year, and I wish you all the best! See you next year.

notes.title: Important News on Egg Surprise & Nortopia
notes.content:
Important News on Nortopia
Dear Egg Surprise players and future Nortopia players, we have two important announcements regarding the Nortopia project that will affect the release dates.

Release Scheduled for 2025
As much as we would like to accelerate the game's release and quickly provide our loyal players with an active experience, unfortunately, the project requires significant efforts to be ready for a commercial release.

Our main goal: is to attract as much attention and interest to Nortopia as possible. For this purpose, we are in search of a publisher who will take on the marketing support for the project.

As a result, the release date has been postponed to Q2 2025, but don’t be disheartened!

Egg Surprise Will Continue to Grow
Our expectation that the concept of Egg Surprise was on its way out has not been fully confirmed. We believed the project had low potential for attracting new players and was gradually fading. However, recent traffic activity has shown that the main reason for audience loss was the high entry barrier to the game. To address this, we plan to significantly lower the entry barrier and improve the game’s friendliness to new players.

The following changes will be made:

Released DLCs will receive new content that moves away from frequent drop changes. Instead, each expansion will feature events that allow players to obtain exclusive, event-bound items
As previously mentioned, we plan to add a heroes mode to the game and offer players the opportunity to duel
We will localize all items and descriptions, as well as integrate comprehensive guides for all features (as previously promised), to help new players understand the game
The current economic balance will also be gradually shifted back toward the initial focus on branches of activity development: farming, exploration, and combat


Conclusion
We strongly recommend players who planned to move to Nortopia soon to reconsider their strategy and actively participate in the Heroes of Egg Surprise expansion, which is designed to add new elements of interest to the project.

notes.title: A very important announcement about the future of this game
notes.content:
Dear players, I would like to share with you our vision of how the development of Egg Surprise and Nortopia will proceed after release.

Nortopia
General Information
This is an MMO Idle strategy game with elements of player trading. As you know, we will transfer items from Egg Surprise to Nortopia following a fair conversion principle. Nortopia plans to develop as a socio-economic strategy with a seasonal model. We sell season passes and cosmetics, while players trade activities and items with each other.
Acquiring Items
All types of items in Nortopia will be available for acquisition through in-game methods, except for seasonal content. To access seasonal content activities, you need to purchase it. Exclusive items transferred from Egg Surprise will be used in the game according to the ownership principle. Players pay in-game currency to use and access these items, and the owners of exclusive items receive revenue in proportion to their ownership share.
Game Mechanics

 Settlement construction
 Dungeons
 Boss raids with players
 Clan activities
 Ranking system and leaderboard


Egg Surprise
After the transfer, this game will undergo a "Reborn." All existing mechanics in the game will be significantly changed, the crafting and spending balance will be completely revised, and for those who transfer items to Nortopia, the inventory will be entirely wiped. This means that if you transfer items, you will lose ownership of them here.

The transfer can be completed within a month after Nortopia's release, but the state of the items will be frozen at the time of the snapshot (screen of all inventory states on the server).

If a player does not use the transfer service, their items will automatically be converted into the local currency at an internal conversion rate, which will not be publicly disclosed but will follow the principle of fairness.

Thus, Egg Surprise will get a soft reboot and a fresh start.

Additionally, the "Heroes of Egg Surprise" DLC will be released, bringing a completely new set of game mechanics.

Mechanics in the Heroes of Egg Surprise DLC

 Customizable player characters
 PVP battles
 Boss branches with drops for unlocking new characters
 Events for obtaining new costumes
 Pets and their customization


Some details may change during development, but the general principles stated here will remain unchanged.

Thank you for your attention, and have a great game!

notes.title: Egg Surprise: Reborn - New Game with Global Changes
notes.content:
Game Refactoring and Major Development Changes Announcement

Introduction
Dear players, we are very grateful for your contribution to the development of the game and your active support of our ideas. When we launched Egg Surprise, to be honest, we did not anticipate such a result and, sadly, were not prepared for such active growth. We had to adapt to the situation, increase protection, engage in very active content expansion, and generally provide service and support for the project’s servers. All of this led to us lacking the focus needed to promote the game.

We made many mistakes in our actions and want to express our immense gratitude for your patience and faith in our development. Finally, we are ready to openly share our plans for the game’s future.

I will now detail what will be reworked and what to expect in the future, and I ask you to be patient and read this post to the end.

Market Economy
Our market economy concept was to create real item scarcity through gameplay. We did not want to fall into the trap of other clickers, where scarcity is created solely by changing drop rates and creating fake items for purchase with developer funds to convince the community of a living economy. We chose to develop gameplay cycles and will continue to develop the project in this way, but we have addressed all the shortcomings associated with our model and are ready to offer you an improved version of this model.


 From now on, there will be no large stockpiles of "cheap" items on the Steam marketplace and in your inventories. They will all become part of the inventory logic and internal trading system. On the Steam marketplace, you will only trade three types of items for real money: different denominations of in-game currency, Pencoin.
 The internal store will represent a market between players with a model similar to Steam’s, but the fee for trading will be Pencoin. This will be a single currency whose value is directly determined by the market, with no possibility of aggressive manipulation.


What problems does this solve?

 Trading will no longer depend on your country’s currency, which caused inconvenience for some regions. Since all item prices will be determined by in-game currency, they will not depend on your country’s exchange rates.
 The game will offer tools for converting Pencoin of different denominations so that players from regions with expensive currencies can buy high-denomination coins in bulk and then convert them in-game into lower-denomination coins.


What else will change in the market model?

 Now, some crafting and activity results will be income in the form of Pencoin, which will reduce the amount of content we need to produce for updates.
 This will also allow for more flexible item balance management and prevent players from losing focus among hundreds of items.
 We will offer a modified item acquisition format, where players will earn in-game currency with some variability depending on luck for active gameplay (such as clicking), rather than final items. All items will now be obtained through crafting and upgrades.


These are not all the changes, but they reflect our readiness to address current issues.

Gameplay
We have taken into account players' comments that the game is too focused on the market model and does not provide gameplay activities for those who did not come to earn money.

I want to assure you that in the revamped version of the game, we have given immense attention to gameplay and focused on making the process as independent as possible from financial relationships. That is, the game will provide all the necessary tools for achieving any values in the game, but of course, it will require a lot of effort and time.


 The game will be completely autonomous from the need to follow news in our communities, chats, and various documents. All necessary instructions and rules for the game will be placed directly in the gameplay.
 You will see most game activities, such as expeditions, crafting, and various activities, displayed on your screen as 2D visuals.
 You will not need to constantly monitor your inventory for the needed resources and will not have to leave the game window to play.
 We will significantly rebalance the game in favor of previously mentioned development branches: farming, military craft, adventuring, and so on. This will be a full-fledged economic strategy with gameplay features, and trading with players will become an option for those who wish to participate.


In other words, our priority is to further develop Egg Surprise into a complete game, not just a simple player-to-player trading simulator. Therefore, we commit to meeting the definition of a game.

Development Discipline
You have repeatedly encountered issues due to developer mistakes or lack of awareness in the project, and we understand that we were wrong. Our idea is to increase the intervals between updates and ensure a proper approach to testing the product before release.


 Before transitioning to the updated model, there will be several rounds of testing before providing you with the final product. We plan to test the project with the first 10 selected people, then 100 people will get access, and only after debugging all errors will we provide access to all players.
 Future updates and project changes will go through testing stages, and if the product is found to be insufficiently ready, we will not publish an "unfinished version" but will take additional time for development.
 Additionally, our approach to development will change in terms of time planning, with announcements of updates or changes occurring only when the planned change is ready.


We greatly appreciate your trust and hope that in the future, we will make far fewer mistakes.

What Will Happen with Old Items and the Current State of the Game?
Considering your investments, we will offer a fair transition to the new model for all current players, allowing you not only to transfer your current progress but also to receive a proportional amount of resources and a new opportunity to reconsider your development strategy in the project. We still do not have a final solution on how exactly this will be implemented, but we are confident that you will like this format.

What decisions can be made now?

 Conversion of all items to in-game currency at the ratio of the current market value of the item.
 Transfer of all items to the format of game items with replacement of some (non-transferable) items at a ratio to the value in the new currency.


The exact solution will be announced later.

Project Promotion and Advertising
The current situation, due to the game looking and playing like a simple clicker, imposes serious limitations on promotion. People are quite skeptical about clickers given the failures and negative advertising associated with them. If the transition to a full-fledged game format happens, we will be able to more actively engage various advertising channels and effectively attract a new audience.


 Additional traffic will be received from players who have never participated in Steam market trading before; they will come to play the game.
 More advertising channels that previously refused us due to the game’s format will be connected.
 Serious preparatory work will be done before attracting players to avoid losing new traffic as we did before.


Conclusion and Announcement
Ladies and gentlemen, we have long been working towards this decision and considered various scenarios for project development, including artificially increasing the online to be noticed by Steam’s algorithms. But after studying the market and seeing unsuccessful cases of such approaches, we made the only viable decision for project development - to become a full-fledged game and stop exploiting the trading platform as the core of the game model.

We aim to create an economic strategy with a focus on created lore and gameplay mechanics, as well as social activities such as raids, clans, PvP, and more.

The game plans to continue its development in this direction, and there will be a very smooth transition from the current game to the new one. This does not mean that there is no reason to continue playing now; all the values earned will become a good start in the new game and allow you to get ahead of other players in development. But we also recognize the importance of maintaining a balance for newcomers and will offer mechanisms for fair competition and development.

Once again, we express our immense gratitude for your help and trust, and we will do everything in our power!
